pr_title: Remove InternalsVisibleTo set for extensions by making necessary internal types public

issue_context.title: Orleans Core public surface insufficient for extension development
issue_context.body:
External and application engineers cannot build extension libraries on Orleans without access to internals.  This is evidenced by our internally maintained extension libraries, many of which require access to Orleans Core internals.

[assembly: InternalsVisibleTo("Orleans.Clustering.AzureStorage")]
[assembly: InternalsVisibleTo("Orleans.Clustering.DynamoDB")]
[assembly: InternalsVisibleTo("Orleans.Hosting.AzureCloudServices")]
[assembly: InternalsVisibleTo("Orleans.Persistence.AzureStorage")]
[assembly: InternalsVisibleTo("Orleans.Persistence.DynamoDB")]
[assembly: InternalsVisibleTo("Orleans.Reminders.AzureStorage")]
[assembly: InternalsVisibleTo("Orleans.Reminders.DynamoDB")]
[assembly: InternalsVisibleTo("Orleans.Streaming.AzureStorage")]
[assembly: InternalsVisibleTo("Orleans.Streaming.EventHubs")]
[assembly: InternalsVisibleTo("Orleans.Streaming.SQS")]
[assembly: InternalsVisibleTo("Orleans.TelemetryConsumers.Counters")]
[assembly: InternalsVisibleTo("Orleans.Transactions.DynamoDB")]

Internal access needs be removed for extension libraries.  Where extension libraries currently require internal access, either alternate solutions need be found or the accessed capabilities need be exposed in maintainable public apis.

review_comments: Should these be in Orleans.Runtime.Internal?  I don't think we want public using these surfaces as, imo, they are subject to change/removal.  If we at least hide them behind an "internal" namespace, then that should mostly hide them and indicate that we're not supporting them as part of our public surface.
Above comment applies to all ICounters

Don't think our error codes should be public.
Makes it more likely app developers will use them, which can create logging confusion.
Suggest well defined ranges of error codes for core, extensions, and services, and move those used by extension libraries into those libraries.
Since existing codes may not conform to the defined ranges, we shouldn't enforce the ranges, but rather make it an 'orleans best practices' problem, wherein communicating the practice is probably sufficient.
See OrleansServiceBusErrorCode for example.
Likewise here. I'd prefer we namespace these to something internal at least, since otherwise we can potentially introduce some clashes
In time we should attempt to remove our dependence on these
I'm fine with leaving it as is.
The main impetus is for semantic logging, since that lets our users perform richer log searches

I'm not huge on exposing these since they are general utility classes. I'd be fine to copy them to the other places that they're needed or even include them via shared source.

Ultimately this is also ok if we don't like the alternatives.
If we organize error codes as described in other comment, we can keep these internal.
